question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
-- Build complete query:
-- 1. Find first movie rating per customer (based on earliest payment date)
-- 2. Get total amount spent per customer (sum of all payments)
-- 3. Get total rentals per customer
-- 4. Join and group by rating

WITH first_payment AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) AS first_payment_date
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
first_payment_detail AS (
    SELECT fp.customer_id, fp.first_payment_date, p.rental_id
    FROM first_payment fp
    JOIN payment p ON fp.customer_id = p.customer_id AND fp.first_payment_date = p.payment_date
),
first_movie AS (
    SELECT fpd.customer_id, f.rating
    FROM first_payment_detail fpd
    JOIN rental r ON fpd.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount_spent,
        COUNT(*) AS num_payments
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_rentals AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_rentals
    FROM rental
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    fm.rating,
    AVG(ct.total_amount_spent) AS avg_total_amount_spent,
    AVG(cr.total_rentals - 1) AS avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_movie fm
JOIN customer_totals ct ON fm.customer_id = ct.customer_id
JOIN customer_rentals cr ON fm.customer_id = cr.customer_id
GROUP BY fm.rating
ORDER BY fm.rating;

{"sql": "-- Build complete query:
-- 1. Find first movie rating per customer (based on earliest payment date)
-- 2. Get total amount spent per customer (sum of all payments)
-- 3. Get total rentals per customer
-- 4. Join and group by rating

WITH first_payment AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) AS first_payment_date
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
first_payment_detail AS (
    SELECT fp.customer_id, fp.first_payment_date, p.rental_id
    FROM first_payment fp
    JOIN payment p ON fp.customer_id = p.customer_id AND fp.first_payment_date = p.payment_date
),
first_movie AS (
    SELECT fpd.customer_id, f.rating
    FROM first_payment_detail fpd
    JOIN rental r ON fpd.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount_spent,
        COUNT(*) AS num_payments
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_rentals AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_rentals
    FROM rental
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    fm.rating,
    AVG(ct.total_amount_spent) AS avg_total_amount_spent,
    AVG(cr.total_rentals - 1) AS avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_movie fm
JOIN customer_totals ct ON fm.customer_id = ct.customer_id
JOIN customer_rentals cr ON fm.customer_id = cr.customer_id
GROUP BY fm.rating
ORDER BY fm.rating;", "preview_rows": 50}
